english:
[font_14]"Spell Potency" refers to the strength of a spell's damage, healing, and stat changes. Typically, a spell's potency scales with the caster's {STAT_intelligence} unless the spell description states otherwise. Many spell descriptions include phrases such as "deals a small amount of damage". Below is a list of how much {STAT_intelligence} is used for each tier of potency. Note that spell damage also penetrates a certain amount of your enemies' {STAT_defense}.

Small Damage: 90% Intelligence, -0% Defense
Moderate Damage: 110% Intelligence, -10% Defense
Large Damage: 120% Intelligence, -20% Defense
Massive Damage: 130% Intelligence, -30% Defense
Devastating Damage: 150% Intelligence, -40% Defense

Small Healing: 30% Intelligence
Moderate Healing: 60% Intelligence
Large Healing: 90% Intelligence
Massive Healing: 120% Intelligence

Small Stats: 20% Intelligence
Moderate Stats: 40% Intelligence
Large Stats: 60% Intelligence
Massive Stats: 80% Intelligence[font_18]

english:
Creatures can attack, cast, receive buffs/debuffs/minions, gain stats, lose stats, take damage, and receive healing a maximum of 15 times per turn, or 5 times per turn when Calm Mode is enabled.

Each creature can only resurrect up to 10 times per battle, or 5 times when Calm Mode is enabled.

Each creature can gain a maximum of 10 traits in battle, or 3 traits when Calm Mode is enabled.

Relics do not count against limits for buffs/debuffs/minions, stats gained, stats lost, times damage was taken, or times healing was received.
german:
Kreaturen können pro Runde maximal 15 Mal angreifen, zaubern, Buffs/Debuffs/Lakaien erhalten, Attribute gewinnen, Attribute verlieren, Schaden nehmen und Heilung empfangen, oder 5 Mal pro Runde, wenn der Ruhige Modus aktiviert ist.

Jede Kreatur kann pro Kampf maximal 10 Mal wiederbelebt werden, oder 5 Mal, wenn der Ruhige Modus aktiviert ist.

Jede Kreatur kann im Kampf maximal 10 Merkmale erhalten, oder 3 Merkmale, wenn der Ruhige Modus aktiviert ist.

Relikte zählen nicht gegen die Limits für Buffs/Debuffs/Lakaien, gewonnene Attribute, verlorene Attribute, erlittenen Schaden oder erhaltene Heilung.

english:
Creatures have five primary stats:

{STAT_health}: creatures lose this when they take damage. If it reaches 0, they die.

{STAT_attack}: increases damage dealt with attacks.

{STAT_intelligence}: increases spell potency.

{STAT_defense}: reduces incoming damage.

{STAT_speed}: determines the creature's starting location on the Timeline. Also increases the creature's chance to dodge attacks, as well as the amount and chance of critical damage.
german:
Kreaturen haben fünf primäre Attribute:

{STAT_health}: Kreaturen verlieren dies, wenn sie Schaden erleiden. Wenn es 0 erreicht, sterben sie.

{STAT_attack}: erhöht den Schaden, der durch Angriffe verursacht wird.

{STAT_intelligence}: erhöht die Wirksamkeit von Zaubern.

{STAT_defense}: reduziert eingehenden Schaden.

{STAT_speed}: bestimmt die Startposition der Kreatur auf der Zeitleiste. Erhöht außerdem die Chance der Kreatur, Angriffen auszuweichen, sowie die Höhe und Wahrscheinlichkeit von kritischem Schaden.

english: Enemies lose fewer stats from stat-reducing effects.
german: Gegner verlieren weniger Attribute durch statuswertreduzierende Effekte.
